title: Think Before You Code: A Benchmark for Testing LLMs on Software Engineering Deliberation
abstract: arXiv:2611.22905v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Think Before You Code (TBYC) is a benchmark pipeline for studying whether code-focused language models can reason about software issues in ways that resemble human engineering deliberation. The benchmark curates GitHub issue discussions into structured records, extracts human discussion artifacts such as problems, solutions, constraints, rationales, and trade-offs, and then prompts models to generate issue-level "thoughts" using retrieved code context and few-shot examples. It converts model responses back into the same artifact space and evaluates them against human annotations using complementary metrics for artifact type detection, metadata matching, tag overlap, and semantic summary similarity. Beyond scoring, this study includes visualization, leaderboard, and baseline tools that make it possible to compare models, prompting strategies, and extraction methods across repositories and issues. translated_title: 先思考再编码：一个测试大语言模型软件工程审慎思考能力的基准
translated_abstract: Think Before You Code（TBYC）是一个基准测试流水线，用于研究以代码为中心的语言模型能否以类似人类工程审慎思考的方式对软件问题进行推理。该基准将GitHub议题讨论整理为结构化记录，提取人类讨论中的产物，如问题、解决方案、约束条件、理由和权衡，然后利用检索到的代码上下文和少样本示例，提示模型生成针对议题的“思考”。它将模型响应转换回相同的产物空间，并使用互补的指标（包括产物类型检测、元数据匹配、标签重叠度和语义摘要相似度）将其与人工标注进行对比评估。除了评分之外，该研究还包括可视化、排行榜和基线工具，使得能够跨仓库和议题比较不同的模型、提示策略和提取方法。Think Before You Code 是一个端到端的评估框架。
tldr: 该研究提出了TBYC基准框架，通过将GitHub议题讨论转化为结构化的工程思考产物并与模型生成的“思考”进行对比评估，来衡量代码大语言模型能否像人类工程师一样审慎地思考软件工程问题。
en_tdlr: TBYC is an end-to-end benchmark pipeline that evaluates whether code-focused LLMs can deliberate on software issues like human engineers by curating GitHub issue discussions into structured artifacts and comparing model-generated thoughts against human annotations.
